X.note: This is a dark recap card over a blurred background. The text is clean and the hierarchy is clear, but it looks like a PowerPoint slide. The subtext is small and gray, and the 'bank line' line is long and dense for a phone. About 40% of the card is empty. The background is so blurred and dark that it adds nothing.

Y.note: This is a good 3D terrain map of San Francisco Bay with a location tag and clear, high-contrast captions. The icons (coin, document, ship, crane) are cute and consistent, but they have no labels, so the viewer can't tell which factor each one stands for. The caption says 'each factor' but doesn't name any. The source line is small.

why: Y is a real, cinematic visual with legible text, while X is a plain text slide with a lot of empty space and a muddy background.
top_fix_for_weaker: Replace the text-only card with a visual recap: three big icon tiles or a mini building diagram (map, stairwell, bank). Give each a one-line label at a larger font, and use the full card area with a brighter, sharper background.
